feature: Reactive DLQ scan — no recent dead-letter entry carries a Postgres schema error (missing column/table = a migration written but never run)
notes: Epic #803. REACTIVE half of the schema-drift pair (proactive half: observability/schema-drift-guard.json).
Intent: prove that in the recent window NOTHING failed into the dead-letter store with a Postgres
schema error — 'column "x" does not exist' / 'relation "y" does not exist' etc. Such an error in
the DLQ is the runtime symptom of a migration that was written in Drizzle TS but never run against live.
WHY THIS DOES NOT CALL GET /admin/dlq (the endpoint the task named):
- GET /api/admin/dlq is gated by requireAdmin (artifacts/api-server/src/middlewares/requireAuth.ts:158)
which demands a real admin-session JWT and has NO ingest-token fallback. The headless BuildConsole
runner authenticates with the {{SECRET_KEY}} ingest token only, so it would get 403 there. By contrast
POST /admin/deploy/sql-test is requireAdminOrIngestToken (accepts {{SECRET_KEY}}) — proven callable by
the already-verified smoke/hello-world-sql.json.
- GET /admin/dlq (admin-dlq.ts:50) also has no time-window filter (only status + limit), so a real
'last 48 hours' window isn't even expressible there.
- Reading msp_dlq_store directly through #896's read-only SELECT runner lets the query (a) scope to a
true 48h window and (b) return ONLY the offending rows with the bad identifier already extracted, so a
failure names the exact column/table instead of a generic 'found some'. CLAUDE.md explicitly blesses
routing DB verification through #896's endpoint.
The query returns the offending rows in $.rows (dlq_id, event_type, created_at, bad_identifier, error_excerpt);
the assertion is $.rowCount == 0. On failure the response body (with bad_identifier + error_excerpt) is
captured in the step's Context for diagnosis. Read-only single SELECT — no forbidden write/DDL keyword, so
it passes the sql-test validator (validateSqlTestQuery, admin-deploy-console.ts:256).
NOT live-verified against the DB from this environment (no DB access here — CLAUDE.md). Authored against
msp_dlq_store as defined at lib/db/src/schema/msp.ts:557. The runner / Shane executes it against live.

body.query: SELECT dlq_id, event_type, to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SSOF') AS created_at, coalesce(substring(error_message from '"([^"]+)"'), '(no-quoted-identifier)') AS bad_identifier, left(error_message, 240) AS error_excerpt FROM msp_dlq_store WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '48 hours' AND (error_message ~* '(column|relation|type|function) "[^"]*" does not exist' OR error_message ~* 'column "[^"]*" of relation "[^"]*" does not exist' OR error_message ILIKE '%does not exist%' OR error_message ILIKE '%undefined column%' OR error_message ILIKE '%undefined table%') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 25
